spans.s: गुम्फ r. 6th cl. (गुम्फति) To string together as a garland, &c.

गुम्फ m. (-म्फः)
 1. Tying, stringing as a garland, &c.
 2. A bracelet.
 3. A
whisker, a mustachio.
 E. गुम्फ to tie or string, affix अच्.

गुम्फित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
 1. Tied, strung.
 2. Arranged, placed in order. E.
गुम्फ to tie, affix क्त; also गुफित, and ग्रन्थित.
